summary: Tested new admin-only Profitability panel end-to-end. Backend POST /api/calc/profitability math (base+labor, shop_rate=101.2, machine hourly add-on, below_cost flag) and RBAC (403 for reseller, 401 unauth) all pass (5/5 pytest). Frontend: panel appears for admin in Stickers and Paper Printing modules, updates on hours/machine change with 300ms debounce, red Loss bar + below-cost alert appears when true cost > quoted price, and panel is correctly hidden for reseller while wholesale price still renders. No layout regression to existing PricingPanel price rows.
critical_code_review_comments: ProfitabilityPanel debounce (300ms) works well; consider also debouncing machine changes if a user rapidly toggles.
estimateHours heuristic in ProfitabilityPanel.js falls back to 0.5h if neither area nor qty are present — fine, but consider surfacing an 'estimated' hint.
In Stickers.js the quoted price fallback uses selling_price OR wholesale_price; ProfitabilityPanel only renders for admin so admins always see retail_total (as expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Profitability panel verified in Stickers (/stickers) and Paper Printing (/paper). Paper route path is /paper (not /paper-printing). PricingPanel from Metric.js wraps the panel in all 11 modules — spot-checked 2 modules; if regressions suspected, spot-check others (booklets/large-format/dtf/etc.).

test_evidence.frontend_admin_stickers: panel visible; initial hours=0.35 true_cost=$50.04 margin=-$6.17; hours=5 -> true_cost=$520.62 margin=-$476.75 + below-cost alert shown; machine select (13 options) increased true_cost $115.82 -> $124.89
test_evidence.frontend_admin_paper: panel visible after selecting product & clicking Calculate; true_cost=$118.10 margin=$84.40; Production/Retail rows still render
test_evidence.frontend_reseller_stickers: profitability-panel count=0; wholesale price ($29.25) still visible
